title: 第一卷 第8章 姜家废物，也配娶我？
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
姜家主殿内，众长老目光灼灼，眼神火热！

    姜临天看向姜无痕，见后者冲他点头，眼神骤然变得坚定。

    “好！”

    “传令，备齐聘礼，将‘那件东西’也带上！”

    “我会将此事告知大帝，请下大帝法旨。待到明日，二长老与我通往太凰仙朝，向长公主沐云溪……提亲！”

    姜临天气势如虹，霸道的声音在殿内回荡。

    姜无痕看着沐云溪的画像投影，嘴角勾起一抹笑意。

    “时隔十几年，长公主……不知是否还记得，当初的约定？”

    而远在太凰仙朝的沐云溪，没来由的背后一凉。

    殊不知，她已经被人给盯上了……

    ……

    帝子殿，寝宫内。

    姜无痕回来的时候，已经临近傍晚。

    林清雅换上了一袭青色衣裙，恢复了往昔的淡雅。

    见姜无痕回来，她温柔唤了声‘夫君’，并下意识的想要褪去衣衫。

    姜无痕见状，却摆手制止了她。

    “夫人，你既有了身孕，前三个月……我们还是注意些，以免动了胎气。”

    听闻此话，林清雅不由得愣了一下。

    今天这是太阳打西边出来了？

    自从成亲到现在，但凡姜无痕在帝子殿，自己都没下过床……

    事出无常必有妖！

    “夫君，不执着于双胞胎了？”

    林清雅语气轻松，带着几分调笑。

    “如果可以，我当然想要……”姜无痕将她揽入怀中，无奈苦笑道，“可我更在意你和孩子的安全……”

    林清雅闻言，心里淌过一阵暖流。

    她轻抿粉唇，在姜无痕的耳畔小声呢喃道：“夫君放心，我能感受到……它很稳定！”

    此话一出，连她自己都愣了一下。

    为什么要说出这种话？

    搞得很像是自己在主动索取一样！

    二人虽是夫妻，但林清雅并不觉得自己会在这么短的时间内，对姜无痕这个陌生男人产生欲求不满的爱意。

    而且，说出这种不检点的话，会不会让夫君以为自己是那种随便的女人？

    “夫君，我不是那个意思……”

    可她的话还没说完，却对上了姜无痕那邪魅的笑意。

    “既然这样，那就在我临走之前，咱们再努力一次！”

    ……

    结束时，已经是后半夜了。

    姜无痕神清气爽的躺在床上，林清雅面露醉人的酡红，柔弱无力的依偎在姜无痕的怀里，享受着温存。

    “夫君，你要出远门了吗？”

    林清雅声音透露着虚弱，美眸流转，柔情似水。

    “明天动身，去一趟太凰仙朝，给你找两个姐妹……”
content_en:
In the main hall of the Jiang family, the elders’ eyes were blazing and fiery!

    Jiang Lintian looked at Jiang Wuhen, and when he saw the latter nodding towards him, his eyes suddenly became firm.

    "Okay!"

    "Send the order, prepare all the betrothal gifts, and bring 'that thing' with you!"

    "I will inform the Emperor of this matter and ask for the Emperor's decree. Until tomorrow, the Second Elder and I will go to the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty to propose marriage to the eldest princess Mu Yunxi...!"

    Jiang Lintian was as powerful as a rainbow, and his domineering voice echoed in the hall.

    Jiang Wuhen looked at the projection of Mu Yunxi's portrait with a smile on his lips.

    "After more than ten years, the eldest princess... I wonder if you still remember the original agreement?"

    Mu Yunxi, who was far away in Taihuang Immortal Dynasty, felt a chill in his back for no reason.

    Little did he know, she was already being targeted...

    …

    The Emperor's Palace, inside the palace.

    When Jiang Wuhen came back, it was already approaching evening.

    Lin Qingya put on a blue dress and regained her former elegance.

    Seeing Jiang Wuhen come back, she gently called "husband" and subconsciously wanted to take off her clothes.

    When Jiang Wuhen saw this, he waved his hand to stop her.

    "Madam, since you are pregnant, in the first three months... we should pay more attention to avoid fetal movement."

    Hearing this, Lin Qingya couldn't help but be stunned for a moment.

    Is the sun coming out in the west today?

    From the moment they got married to now, whenever Jiang Wuhen is in the Emperor's Palace, he has never gotten out of bed...

    When things go wrong, there must be a demon!

    "Husband, are you no longer obsessed with twins?"

    Lin Qingya's tone was relaxed and a bit teasing.

    "If I can, of course I want to..." Jiang Wuhen took her into his arms and said with a helpless smile, "But I care more about the safety of you and the child..."

    When Lin Qingya heard this, a warm current flowed through her heart.

    She lightly pursed her pink lips and whispered in Jiang Wuhen's ear: "Don't worry, husband, I can feel...it's very stable!"

    As soon as these words came out, even she was stunned for a moment.

    Why do you say this?

    It’s as if I’m actively asking for it!

    Although the two were husband and wife, Lin Qingya didn't think that she would develop unsatisfactory love for Jiang Wuhen, a strange man, in such a short period of time.

    Moreover, if she says such inappropriate words, will her husband think that she is that kind of casual woman?

    "Husband, I didn't mean that..."

    But before she finished speaking, she met Jiang Wuhen's evil smile.

    "In this case, let's work hard again before I leave!"

    …

    When it ended, it was late at night.

    Jiang Wuhen was lying on the bed refreshed, while Lin Qingya's face showed an intoxicating blush. She snuggled weakly into Jiang Wuhen's arms, enjoying the tenderness.

    "Husband, are you going on a long trip?"

    Lin Qingya's voice revealed weakness, and her beautiful eyes were as tender as water.

    "Leave tomorrow and go to Taihuang Immortal Dynasty to find two sisters for you..."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 8 The Jiang family’s trash is worthy of marrying me?
